title: Degreewise stalk tensor comparison
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space, $x\in X$, and $T$ its module stalk functor [def-pc-module-stalk-functor]. Suppose a family of module isomorphisms $\varphi_{A,B}:T(A\otimes B)\cong T(A)\otimes T(B)$ is given for all sheaves of modules. For all cochain complexes $F,K$ [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] and integers $n$, there are isomorphisms $e_{F,K,n}:T(\operatorname{Tot}(F\otimes K)^n)\cong\operatorname{Tot}(TF\otimes TK)^n$ [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] such that for every $p+q=n$, $T(\iota_{p,q})e_{F,K,n}=\varphi_{F^p,K^q}\iota_{p,q}$, where $\iota$ denotes the relevant total-degree coproduct injection.

source.place: Cohomology, Lemma Tag 06YB (label lemma-check-K-flat-stalks), tensor-stalk identification

proof.text: Apply [lem-pc-stalk-direct-sums] to the diagonal coproduct of tensor sheaves. Its germ formula implies the corresponding categorical injection formula: represent an arbitrary germ and apply the formula. If the diagonal index has smaller universe, first lift it to the sheaf universe and reindex the coproduct using the lift equivalence. The scalar ring in the direct-sum statement is the RingCat stalk; canonically identify it with the CommRingCat stalk used by [def-pc-module-stalk-functor]. Both scalar actions on germs are given by the germ of the sectionwise scalar product, so representing the scalar on a neighborhood verifies compatibility and transports the linear equivalence.

Identify the direct sum of stalks with the categorical module coproduct, using ModuleCat.coprodIsoDirectSum (Mathlib/Algebra/Category/ModuleCat/Products.lean, lines 99-109). Compose with the coproduct of the given component isomorphisms. The coproduct injection formula gives the asserted equation.
